title: Range Estimator
text: Range Estimator 模块估计从雷达响应数据中获得的目标检测的距离，输入 5 路、输出 2 路；{Maximum number of estimates} 指定要报告的最大估计数、{Enable cluster ID input} 启用聚类 ID 输入、{Output variance for parameter estimates} 启用输出方差端口、{Root-mean-square range resolution} 指定距离分辨率、{Source of noise power} 指定噪声功率值来源、{Noise power} 指定噪声功率值、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: Resp
ports.summary: 经过距离处理的响应数据立方体 complex-valued P -by-1 column vector | complex-valued M -by- P matrix | complex-valued M -by- N -by- P matrix

ports.name: Range
ports.summary: 沿距离维的距离网格值 real-valued M -by-1 column vector

ports.name: DetIdx
ports.summary: 检测索引 real-valued N d -by- Q matrix

ports.name: NoisePower
ports.summary: 检测位置处的噪声功率 positive scalar | real-valued 1-by- Q row vector of positive values

ports.name: Clusters
ports.summary: 聚类 ID real-valued 1-by- Q row vector of positive values

ports.name: Est
ports.summary: 距离估计值 real-valued K -by-1 column vector

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: 距离估计方差 positive, real-valued K -by-1 column vector

params.name: Maximum number of estimates
params.values: 要报告的最大估计数 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable cluster ID input
params.values: 启用聚类 ID 输入 off (default) | on

params.name: Output variance for parameter estimates
params.values: 启用输出方差端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Source of noise power
params.values: 噪声功率值来源 Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
